sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Keeps a video's view on one detection, as map-follow keeps a map on one track: the player comes in on the part of the picture around it and moves with it, and a banner in a corner says what is followed, or that the finder has lost it, with a button that lets it go.

anatomy.container: The banner, in the player's top corner over the picture: a row 6 apart, padded 8 at its start, 2 at its end and 2 down, on terminal/80 with a blur behind, rounded by radius-control, in terminal-foreground at text.xs.
anatomy.mark: A crosshair 14 square in the detection's color (track-<affiliation>, or primary without one), at half strength while it is lost.
anatomy.name: Following and its name (its label and id, or its id alone) at 500, cut with an ellipsis; Lost and its name while the finder has lost it.
anatomy.release: An icon button (extra small) with an X that lets it go, named by its word.
anatomy.view: The picture, with what the picture layer draws, scaled about its corner so the region around the detection fills the player: room times the detection's larger side, never less than a fifth of the picture or more than all of it, centered on the detection and kept inside the picture; the picture never leaves bare an edge of the player it covered. Each step is eased. Let go, the whole picture again.

detection.does: The detection followed: its id, label, affiliation and samples, as detection-overlay takes them.

onRelease.does: Called when the viewer lets it go by the banner's button.

room.does: How many of the detection's own sizes the view holds around it.

time.does: The moment followed; inside a video player it follows the video without it.

offset.does: Seconds added to the time before the samples are read.

hold.does: How long it counts as seen after its last sample, in seconds.

gap.does: The longest gap between two samples it glides across, in seconds.

rest.means: Following: the view on the detection, the banner naming it.

lost.means: The finder has lost it: the view held where it was last seen, the banner saying Lost, its mark at half strength.
lost.reached: no sample within hold of the moment

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the release button: the focus ring around it.

sokkel-ui: The view is a CSS transform on the box that holds the video and the picture layer, set through the picture context's setView (useVideoView) and eased by a transition, so following moves no React state per frame in the player.
While zoomed, what the picture layer draws scales with the picture, its tags included.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
